purpose: Separate conversational behavior from numerical equivalence and performance.
scoring: Strict declared instruction and answer gates; answer_present is recorded separately from exact formatting.
identity_regression_scope: reported_recovery is an extra case excluded from the general suite because model identity is supplied by the system prompt.

results.text: Hello! I'm an AI assistant. What can I help you with?

findings: Presence penalties 0 and 1.5 both returned exactly 7319 and Cedar in the fixed retrieval cases at seed 42.
Presence penalty 0 recovered the supplied repetitive history on the identity question with current system prompts/reminders.
No improvement from changing the default presence penalty was demonstrated by this small ablation.
Do not change default decoding or add UI penalty controls based solely on these results.
limitations: Only two general retrieval cases and one supplied-history regression were run in this ablation, each at one seed.
No sampled cached-versus-fresh or repeatability runs were executed in this window; the runner supports both.
Passing identity questions is not proof of general conversational quality; vague follow-ups remain a known weakness.
A report from the sibling matched-benchmark work found only 4/9 strict passes for native FP32, FP16, and Q4; consult build/matched-native-quality.json for its raw results.
These initial ablation artifacts lack a binary digest; future runner executions record binary and model-config SHA256 values.
Sampled token sequences must not be claimed equivalent across engines because RNG and penalty scope differ.
These are quality observations, not speed measurements or broad model capability scores.
next_evaluations: Run all nine frozen cases at multiple seeds for presence penalties 0 and 1.5 before choosing a default.
Use --repeatability and --cache-check on longer histories to detect state/RNG regressions separately from semantic failures.
Compare every optimized numerical backend to the same greedy logits/prompts first, then evaluate sampled quality separately.
validation: uv run --locked python -m unittest tests.test_conversation_eval -v (4 passing tests)
